description: Generic flow to authenticate user via OTP sent to cell or email

parameters.name: email_validator
parameters.description: OPTIONAL flow name. When supplied, it is called with {email} before an email OTP is sent and MUST set contact_valid=true to allow the send. contact_valid.description: Whether the contact may receive an OTP. True when no validator applies; otherwise the validator must set it true (fail-closed).

unverified_contact.description: The contact that failed validation, phrased for the retry message ('the number 555…' / 'the email a@b.c'). Computed so cell and email share ONE rejection branch.
